prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: six separated sprite parts for an existing Unity cartoon chicken, front view while moving DOWN on the screen.
Input image 1: complete assembled original AdvancedHen; use for character identity, proportions, style and colors.
Input image 2: original side-view parts atlas; use for the black outline, fills, expression variants and modular construction.
Primary request: redraw this SAME chicken from the FRONT, facing the viewer, for vertical downwards walking. Produce NEW perspective artwork. Do not rotate, stretch or flip the reference sideways chicken. Match its thick clean black outline, flat shaded vector-like cartoon painting, red/orange comb, brown spotted head and neck, cream feather torso, pale cream wings, yellow beak and yellow feet. Preserve its large silly pale eyes and compact plump body. No realistic textures or new accessories.
Composition: exactly 1536x1024 pixels, a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, each cell 512x512. Every cell contains ONLY ONE detached body part, centered, with at least 48 pixels of empty padding. No grid lines or labels. Flat pure RGB(255,0,255) magenta backdrop throughout, no gradients, no shadows, no magenta in the chicken.
TOP LEFT: normal front-facing head and brown neck, detached without body or legs; include comb, both large eyes and centered yellow beak. TOP MIDDLE: the identical front head and neck, same outline, size and alignment, but angry expression. TOP RIGHT: the identical front head and neck, same outline, size and alignment, but dazed/dead expression with closed or rolled eyes. Head dimensions, comb location and neck base must match between all three variants.
BOTTOM LEFT: ONLY the plump cream front-facing torso with subtle cream/brown spots; no neck, head, face, feet or attached wings. The neck attaches near the top. BOTTOM MIDDLE: ONLY ONE detached cream wing seen from the front, narrow and vertical, black outline, clear feather tips, suitable for mounting at the left side of that torso; the opposite wing is mirrored locally in Unity. BOTTOM RIGHT: ONLY ONE detached short yellow leg and three-toed foot seen from the front, with a small cream feather cuff. The second leg will reuse this sprite.
Constraints: the parts must combine into the SAME original character seen from the front, with a matching color palette and stroke weight. No complete chickens in any cell, no extra parts, no text or watermark. Keep all content strictly inside its assigned cell. This is game production artwork, not a concept illustration or mockup.

Match the assembled reference red comb and warm brown neck. Each part must be fully isolated, opaque with solid flat color inside its black outline. Background is absolutely flat pure magenta #FF00FF, suitable for lossless background removal. No sheet border or captions. Produce only these six detached parts, not a full character.
